# How to Turn Your Work Notes into a Clear AI Brief in Minutes

You just finished a long meeting with your team. The whiteboard is covered in scribbles, someone sent a voice note with half the details, and the Slack thread is 47 messages long. Now you need to write a root-cause brief for your manager by 3pm. What if you could paste all of that into an AI tool and get a polished, professional brief back in seconds?

ChatGPT Work is designed to do exactly that. It’s a workspace inside ChatGPT that helps you build clear, structured documents from real work inputs—like meeting notes, KPIs, or project updates. You don’t need to be a data scientist to use it. You just need to know how to feed it the right information and guide it toward the tone and structure you want.

Here’s how to turn your messy notes into a clean brief, memo, or spec—without rewriting everything yourself.

---

## Start with a simple prompt: “Turn this into a root-cause brief”

Open ChatGPT Work and paste your raw notes into the chat. These could be:

- A screenshot of your whiteboard
- A voice note transcript
- A Slack thread or email chain
- A spreadsheet export or dashboard screenshot

Then, give a clear instruction like:

> Turn this into a root-cause brief. Include:
> - The main issue
> - 3 contributing factors
> - 2 immediate actions
> - 1 KPI to track

ChatGPT Work will process your input and generate a structured brief. You can edit it directly in the tool, add data, or ask it to shorten, simplify, or focus on a specific angle.

---

## Build a KPI memo from scattered numbers

You’ve got a spreadsheet with sales data, customer feedback, and support tickets. Instead of copying and pasting into a slide deck, use ChatGPT Work to turn it into a KPI memo.

Paste your data into the chat and say:

> Create a KPI memo from this data. Focus on:
> - Top 3 metrics that changed this month
> - Why they changed (in plain language)
> - One recommendation for next steps

The tool will extract the key numbers, add context, and format it into a professional memo you can share with your team or leadership.

---

## Draft a dashboard spec from a rough sketch

You’ve sketched a dashboard on paper or in a note app. Instead of spending hours building it in a BI tool, use ChatGPT Work to draft a clear spec.

Paste your sketch or bullet points like:

> Dashboard title: Customer Support Performance
> Metrics: Average response time, tickets resolved, customer satisfaction
> Filters: Date range, team, issue type

Then ask:

> Turn this into a dashboard spec. Include:
> - Purpose
> - Key metrics and how they’re calculated
> - Suggested visualizations
> - Data sources needed

You’ll get a structured spec you can hand off to your analytics team or build yourself.

---

## What this means for you

- **In everyday life**: Use it to turn your grocery list notes or party planning scribbles into a clear to-do list or timeline. No more forgotten items or double bookings.

- **For your business or work**: Use it to draft client reports, project updates, or meeting recaps from raw notes—saving hours each week and making your communication clearer and more professional.

- **If you're just getting started**: Start with a small note or email thread. Paste it into ChatGPT Work, give a simple instruction like “turn this into a bullet-point summary,” and see how it transforms your messy input into something clean and useful.

---

ChatGPT Work isn’t about replacing your thinking—it’s about turning your raw, real-world inputs into polished, professional outputs faster. Try it with your next messy set of notes and see how much time you save.
